Toledo v1.4 Core Epistemic Structure merge (proposal PROP-CES-2026-09-07-01, Core Epistemic Structure of a project, origin: Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217 (founder ruling), applied first in the Economics of Expertise manuscript v1.0.1, Blackbox Log ruling BBL-2026-09-07-217, (i), doi 10.5281/zenodo.22302518): Core Epistemic Structure of a project p: E_p = <X_p^exp, X_p^int, M_p^AI> -- the experience-based expertise slot, the interactional-expertise slot, and the AI-model set of that project, kept as three non-collapsing components. Founder ruling, Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217.

Toledo v1.4 Core Epistemic Structure merge (proposal PROP-CES-2026-09-07-02, AI model set of a project, origin: Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217 (founder ruling), applied first in the Economics of Expertise manuscript v1.0.1, Blackbox Log ruling BBL-2026-09-07-217, (ii), doi 10.5281/zenodo.22302518): M_p^AI = {M_1,...,M_k}: the AI models materially used on project p, recorded as a set -- membership only, no ranking or weighting implied. Founder ruling, Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217.

Toledo v1.4 Core Epistemic Structure merge (proposal PROP-CES-2026-09-07-03, Interactional-expert slot empty when the role is unheld, origin: Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217 (founder ruling), applied first in the Economics of Expertise manuscript v1.0.1, Blackbox Log ruling BBL-2026-09-07-217, (iii), doi 10.5281/zenodo.22302518): X_p^int = the empty set when no interactional expert holds the role on project p -- an unheld role, not a zero score against some scale. Founder ruling, Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217.

Toledo v1.4 Core Epistemic Structure merge (proposal PROP-CES-2026-09-07-04, Non-collapse: experience-based expertise, interactional expertise, and AI model are distinct, origin: Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217 (founder ruling), applied first in the Economics of Expertise manuscript v1.0.1, Blackbox Log ruling BBL-2026-09-07-217, (iv), doi 10.5281/zenodo.22302518): Non-collapse rule: Experience-Based Expertise != Interactional Expertise != AI Model -- none of the three Core Epistemic Structure components may be treated as reducible to, or substitutable for, another. Founder ruling, Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217.

Toledo v1.4 Core Epistemic Structure merge (proposal PROP-CES-2026-09-07-05, Experience-holder decomposition (lived experience, selection, interpretation), origin: Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-217 (founder ruling), applied first in the Economics of Expertise manuscript v1.0.1, Blackbox Log ruling BBL-2026-09-07-217, (v), doi 10.5281/zenodo.22302518): Experience-holder decomposition: X_p^exp = <Exp, Sel, Int> -- lived experience, selection, and interpretation as the three components of an experience-based expert's contribution. From BBL-2026-09-07 rulings the same day as BBL-2026-09-07-217.
